rule: Counts and seeds fixed before any qualification trial. No retune. No early stop on a favorable or unfavorable interval. No substitution of a smaller sample. No pooling with 127xxx, 130xxx, the 400-seed screen, or the selection block.

candidate.law: short_step_balance after the slow-yaw integral and k_yaw_phase. Pitch branch only while pitch < -pitch_on and pitch rate < 0: stance thigh forward, swing foot less forward. Heading trim on the phase-stance hip only. No sole force.

baseline.name: frozen short-step trajectory
baseline.note: Same gait and controller as the 3978/4000 qualification, with short_balance absent. That 3978/4000 result is not rewritten and is not pooled.

physics: unchanged fall rule 45 deg or COM height < 0.6 start; randomization mass ±10%, friction 0.6-1.0, armature/damping ±30%, latency 0-5 steps of 2 ms, backlash 0.4 deg; STS3215 stall clip ±1.91 N·m

criterion_nominal_10s.support: lower bound >= 0.995 on the candidate nominal 10 s trials only
criterion_nominal_10s.scope: this seed distribution and 10 s horizon on the 0.84258 kg head only; not physical safety; not 20 s; not mass bounds

order: Complete cand nom10 (4000) before base nom10. Then nom20 both, lo10 both, hi10 both. Do not stop because an interval already clears or misses.
screen_not_qualification: Seeds 142000-142399 were a 400-seed paired screen. They are not part of this distribution.
diagnostic_not_qualification: The 22 misses of seeds 130000-133999 were used only to read the pitch-versus-yaw time order. They are not in this sample.
